title: Resolve a verification problem through its responsible owner
goal: Determine whether the current work and evidence justify final completion and route any failure correctly.
context: The complete implementation is submitted for final Verify with a claimed whole-change approval whose presence and applicability must be assessed.
trigger: Final Verify evaluates the current scope and evidence.
preconditions: The requested scope and relevant project authority are identifiable.

interaction.action: Inspects current subjects, governing obligations, review applicability and actual evidence.
Classifies an observed gap as an engineering defect, evidence-collection issue or contradictory assessment basis.
Identifies the responsible correction and required reassessment or verification retry.
Makes a final completion claim only when the applicable basis and evidence support it.

expected_outcome: Verify remains distinct from authoring and Code Review, with correction proportional to the observed problem.

alternatives.condition: Only evidence collection failed and engineering subjects did not change.
alternatives.outcome: The collection issue is resolved and affected verification repeated without inventing a new Code Review gate.

failures.condition: Whole-change approval is missing or inapplicable.
failures.outcome: Governed final success is withheld; Verify cannot substitute for Code Review.
The defect returns to Implement, followed by affected independent reassessment and renewed Verify.

failures.condition: A requirement or design defect, or contradictory new evidence, is discovered.
failures.outcome: The responsible upstream owner or assessment owner addresses it before renewed reliance; Verify does not silently fix and approve authored work.

sources.basis: User-selected requirement-first workflow and one mandatory whole-change Code Review gate. Proposed requirement analysis only; existing product contracts remain active until coordinated adoption. No new Function, AR, implementation or approval is inferred.

Document-based author assessment under the explicit Constitution exception confirms this Scenario as requirement-analysis knowledge. It is not independent review, executed product evidence or workflow activation.
